caption: The video captures a nighttime view of a wide waterfall lit with steady blue light along its falling curtain. A massive cloud of mist rises from the crest and billows continuously, its top edge and side contours deforming as it churns and reshapes instead of moving rigidly. In the foreground, the dark water surface churns with shifting ripples, while a metal railing sits at the lower left and a rock at the lower center. Warm city lights line the left horizon and a string of white lights crosses the right, with a single bright point glowing through the mist within the plume. A slight handheld drift shifts these fixed elements against the frame edges.
